verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own Google Sheets/Drive connector imports a sheet or Excel file into the Model and updates the Model when the file changes, which covers one direction: spreadsheet edits flowing into the product. It can also download a Page as an Excel workbook that keeps its formulas, but that is a static export, not a live pull. missing for 10: an actual Excel or Google Sheets add-in, live data refreshing into the spreadsheet, true bi-directional write-back from the add-in, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
